settings.title: Shop All Styles & Colors
settings.body: One patented grip system, two builds. Closed Sole wraps your entire foot. Open Sole frees your heel for a barefoot feel. Same 360° grip, same durability, same $74. Choose the one that fits your practice.
settings.closed_desc: Full coverage including heel — more protection everywhere. 360° grip across the entire underfoot. Ideal for reformer footwork, barre, Lagree, and any studio discipline where full-foot lockdown matters.
settings.open_desc: Open heel with a mid-foot vent — your heel contacts the surface directly for a grounded, barefoot-like feel with extra airflow. Same 360° grip where it matters most. Ideal for mat work, yoga, and heated studios.

settings.headline: Grip That Holds Where It Matters Most

settings.title: Never Loses Grip.
settings.body: Tired of dots that peel and socks that stretch out? Injection-molded grip won't peel or flake like silicone dots — not after 100 classes, not after 1,000. Wipe clean. One pair.

settings.title: Commit to the Gear.
settings.body: Stop buying another pair every few months. You already invest the time and energy — your footwear should match. Locked grip. No adjust. One pair. Done.

settings.question: Grippy shoes for barre — trusted in studios from NYC to LA
settings.answer: Barre instructors and clients choose Barreletics for relevé stability, pulse work precision, and zero-adjustment transitions. Full-contact grip replaces socks that stretch and slip.

settings.question: Grippy shoes for reformer — from Miami to San Francisco
settings.answer: Reformer footwork demands locked-in feet on the carriage. Barreletics' injection-molded grip holds through every spring setting and every transition — no resets, no sliding.

settings.question: Grippy shoes for Pilates and Lagree — Chicago, Dallas, Austin and beyond
settings.answer: Mat Pilates, tower work, Megaformer sessions — one pair of Barreletics replaces the drawer of worn-out socks. Grip that won't peel or flake like silicone dots.

settings.question: Grippy shoes for yoga — hot studios, cold studios, every studio
settings.answer: Whether you practice in heated studios or traditional settings, Barreletics deliver grip through sweat, transitions, and sustained holds. Open Sole for a barefoot feel. Closed Sole for full coverage.
